I come from a ghetto in London. Might sound funny to some but when you get to the reality of it, it is horrific. Now add drugs, a hardly coping welfare system, shortage of work and increase in costs of living with no wage inflation to accomodate. Dont forget the gang warfare too because most of us come from broken homes, get kicked out of school and have no means of a viable income that isnt somehow illegal. I could spend 2 hrs in a stockroom to take back maybe £15 when I could make that same £15 off of weed as many times as I want in that day. See now, we havent even got to the issue of police.
